# One Life

> One Life is a small company that builds simple apps for daily life. The apps are the products people use; One Life stays in the background, and each app carries the credit "a One Life product". Its first app is Luten, sound with sections for sleep, focus, stress and ADHD on iPhone and Android. Its second is Cassette, an AI note taker for iPhone and Android.

Website: https://www.onelifeco.app/
Contact: contact@onelifeco.app

## Apps and status

- [Luten](https://www.onelifeco.app/luten/): sound for the mind, with sections for Sleep, Focus, Stress, ADHD and Kids. Available now on the App Store for iPhone, with an Apple Watch app, and on Google Play for Android.
- [Cassette](https://www.onelifeco.app/cassette/): a cassette deck for iPhone and Android that records meetings, lectures and voice memos, then writes the transcript, summary, action items and a follow-up email. Available now on the App Store for iPhone and on Google Play for Android.
- [Spend](https://www.onelifeco.app/apps/spend/): daily expense tracking. In development, with a waitlist.
- Still and Move: in development. No details published yet.

## Luten

What it is: an app for iPhone and Android that plays sound picked by how you feel. It is sound, not guided meditation. You pick a need, or tell Sona, the in-app chat, how you feel, and press play. There is no course to finish.

Who it is for: people who want sound to sleep, work, study or wind down to, and parents at a child's bedtime.

Key features:
- Five modes: Sleep, Focus, Stress, ADHD and Kids.
- White noise, pink noise, brown noise, rain, ocean, fan, cafe, library, forest and world soundscapes. No sound has narration or lyrics, nearly every track has even loudness, and loops are crossfaded.
- Sona, a chat that suggests a real track from how you describe your feelings. Sona runs on the phone, and what you type stays on the phone.
- A sleep timer that fades the sound out, a focus timer, a Pomodoro-style timer in ADHD mode, and simple guided breathing.
- On iPhone, a sleep score built from your Apple Health data, with duration, deep sleep, REM, interruptions and vitals.
- Background and lock-screen playback, and on iPhone a home-screen widget, an Apple Watch app, iMessage stickers and family profiles.

Platforms: iPhone and Apple Watch (App Store), and Android phones (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.luten.android).

Pricing: free to download, with an optional subscription. Every subscription starts with a 7-day free trial.

Privacy: Sona runs on the device. One Life runs no third-party advertising in its apps and does not sell personal information. Full details are in the Privacy Policy.

Account deletion: delete your account in the app under Profile, then Subscription, then Delete Account, or ask by email without opening the app. What is deleted, what is kept and for how long: https://www.onelifeco.app/luten/delete-account/

Wellness: Luten is for relaxation, focus and rest. It is not a medical device, makes no medical claims and does not treat any condition.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/luten-sleep-focus-sounds/id6777673392

## Cassette

What it is: an iPhone and Android app styled as a cassette deck. Press Record in a meeting, lecture or conversation, and Cassette writes the transcript, a short summary, highlights, action items with owners and due dates when they are mentioned, and a follow-up email draft.

One tap to record: a tape can start from a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget, or from a Record button in Control Center, on the Lock Screen or on the Action button (iOS 18 or later), and the Dynamic Island shows the recording, where it can be paused or marked.

Apple Watch: an Apple Watch app records with the watch's microphone, with pause and stop, and sends each tape to the iPhone for its transcript and notes; a watch face complication or Siri starts one.

Pricing: free to download and to record, with no minute meter. Tapes under 3 minutes get their transcript and notes free, and longer ones get them free for 2 tapes a month. Cassette Premium writes up every tape and backs up your recordings, billed weekly, monthly or annually; the annual plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

Privacy: tapes are stored on the phone, and an account is optional. On iPhone, tapes are included in iCloud and computer backups if the user has them on, and a user who signs in with Premium backs tapes up to their account. Transcripts come from Apple speech recognition, on the device where the language is supported; otherwise that recording may be sent to Apple to transcribe. Notes are written by Apple's models, never by an outside AI service: on iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence through Apple's Private Cloud Compute, which does not keep the transcript, and on earlier iPhones on the device. An On-device only switch stops all of this and keeps every tape on the iPhone.

Offline: recording always works in airplane mode. Transcripts and notes do too once the language has downloaded, and on Android once the notes model has arrived over Wi-Fi after install. Full notes need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 26 or later; other iPhones get the recording, the transcript and a few lines quoted from the tape.

Android: the same deck on Google Play, Android 10 or later. Transcripts are written on the phone by the Whisper model that comes with the app, and the notes by Cassette's own notes model on phones with 8 GB of memory or more; other phones get simpler notes. The audio is never sent anywhere to be transcribed or written up.

Requirements: any iPhone on iOS 17 or later, or any Android phone on Android 10 or later.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cassette-ai-note-taker/id6812001404 (iPhone, iPad, Mac) and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.cassette.deck (Android)
